title: A question nobody answers
about: Egg Head gives the call 2.5 s to answer a question about a system, then takes it and answers once the lookup is back. If anyone answers first, it stays out.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: What are we seeing on the orders API?
lines.why: a question to the call; Jordan answers it within 2.5 s

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: Orders API is throwing a lot of 500s.
lines.why: answered, and true: nothing to do

lines.speaker: Lee
lines.text: Did anyone push anything to the payments API today?
lines.why: nobody answers for 2.5 s, so Egg Head takes it, then answers when the lookup is back
